title: Spartix Wiki Update Packet Schema
description: Defines the structure of a Wiki Update Packet sent by CO to WKC for recording project events in the wiki.

packetId.description: Unique wiki update packet identifier. Format: WU-YYYY-NNN.

sentBy.description: The agent that sent this packet. Must always be CO.

sentAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when CO sent this packet.

updateType.description: Type of wiki update determining which page is affected.

updateContent.description: The actual content to be recorded in the wiki.

entryTitle.description: Title for the new entry or status update.

entryContent.description: Full content to be recorded in the wiki.

relatedTaskPacketId.description: Reference to the originating task packet if applicable.

relatedAgent.description: Which agent produced the content being recorded.

context.description: Context about what triggered this update.

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the wiki entry.
